Cause (read from code, not yet tested in a car): each sentence is its own clip (server tts-manager.ts:106, sent only after the previous is confirmed at :224); the app releases its audio session when the queue goes idle (app audio-engine.native.ts:91, playback.ts onIdle), so the car drops A2DP to radio between clips. Fix A: delay releaseSessionIfIdle by about 1.5 s after the queue empties. App-side, so it needs our own Android app build (the App Store phone app cannot take it); also worth filing upstream. Workaround already in place: speak tool description tells agents to send the whole report in one call (0.12.0-df commit 8d18facf6). Des 22 Oct: medium-term, P3.

title: Bug: after a speak finishes, Des's phone keeps the car Bluetooth audio instead of releasing it

note: GOAL: the phone releases audio focus and the car audio link as soon as a speak finishes, so the car goes back to its own source. BUG reported by Des via Zoe, Thu 22 Oct 2026 about 19:25 IST, in the speak feature we shipped: after his last speak call finished (the tool returned ok), his phone never released the audio back to the car; car Bluetooth stayed on the phone. WHERE TO LOOK (first read of the code, not yet tested on a phone): the app releases the session only through releaseSessionIfIdle in packages/app/src/audio/audio-engine.native.ts:91-100, which calls native.releaseAudioSession() once the playback queue is idle. That call was added upstream in fb5cfb9fb (#2866, Release the audio session when voice capture and playback go idle). The code comment says the wrapper NO-OPS on app binaries whose native module predates it. Des's phone app is the App Store/Play build, so first check which build he has and whether releaseAudioSession exists in it and abandons Android audio focus; NOT CONFIRMED. Also check the PCM path (playPcm16 via ensureInitialized) really reaches onIdle after a speak. CONSTRAINT FOR o4 (fix A, keep the session open between sentences): it must stay open only between sentences of ONE speak and close shortly after the LAST sentence. A keep-alive that never closes would make this bug worse. Related to but separate from o5 (no audio at all after the app sat unused). RULES: do not install anything on Des's phone without telling him first. Report to Des directly. Not started; Des has not asked for a fix yet.
